```{r}
  mutate(
    clinvar_group = case_when(
      clinvar_clinical_significance %in% c("pathogenic", "likely_pathogenic") ~
        "Pathogenic",
      clinvar_clinical_significance %in% c("benign", "likely_benign") ~
        "Benign",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    clinvar_group = factor(
      clinvar_group,
      levels = c(
        "Pathogenic",
        "Benign",
        "Other"
      )
    )
  )
head(clinvar_df)
```

```{r, fig.width=4.5, fig.height=4.5}
# 1. Prepare Data
roc_data <- clinvar_df %>%
  filter(clinvar_group %in% c("Pathogenic", "Benign")) %>%
  drop_na(ESM.1v) %>%
  mutate(
    # Binary Truth: 1 = Pathogenic, 0 = Benign
    truth = ifelse(clinvar_group == "Pathogenic", 1, 0)
  )

# 2. Manual ROC Calculation
# We sweep through all unique ESM scores as potential thresholds
thresholds <- sort(unique(roc_data$ESM.1v))
# Add infinity to handle the edge case where no variants are called pathogenic
thresholds <- c(-Inf, thresholds, Inf)

# Function to calculate metrics for a single threshold
calc_metrics <- function(cutoff, data) {
  # Predict: Lower score (< cutoff) = Pathogenic (1)
  # Adjust direction if your score means Higher = Pathogenic
  pred <- ifelse(data$ESM.1v < cutoff, 1, 0)
  
  tp <- sum(pred == 1 & data$truth == 1)
  tn <- sum(pred == 0 & data$truth == 0)
  fp <- sum(pred == 1 & data$truth == 0)
  fn <- sum(pred == 0 & data$truth == 1)
  
  sens <- tp / (tp + fn)
  spec <- tn / (tn + fp)
  fpr <- 1 - spec
  
  # Return data frame row
  data.frame(threshold = cutoff, sensitivity = sens, specificity = spec, fpr = fpr)
}

# Run calculation for all thresholds (using vectorized approach for speed)
# Note: For very large datasets, a loop might be slow, but for gene-sized data it's fine.
roc_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(thresholds, calc_metrics, data = roc_data)) %>%
  distinct(sensitivity, specificity, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  arrange(fpr, sensitivity)

# 3. Calculate AUC (Trapezoidal Rule)
# Sort by FPR
auc_data <- roc_table %>% arrange(fpr)
auc_val <- sum(diff(auc_data$fpr) * (head(auc_data$sensitivity, -1) + tail(auc_data$sensitivity, -1))) / 2
# AUC is usually positive; flip if direction was wrong
auc_val <- abs(auc_val)

# 4. Find Thresholds

# A. Youden Index (Sensitivity + Specificity - 1)
youden_row <- roc_table %>%
  mutate(youden = sensitivity + specificity - 1) %>%
  arrange(desc(youden)) %>%
  slice(1)

# B. Strict Cutoff (>95% Specificity)
strict_row <- roc_table %>%
  filter(specificity >= 0.95) %>%
  arrange(specificity, desc(sensitivity)) %>%
  slice(1)

# Update the variable you need for downstream analysis
best_cutoff <- strict_row$threshold

# 5. Print Comparison
print("--- Standard (Youden/Balanced) Cutoff ---")
print(paste("Cutoff:", round(youden_row$threshold, 3)))
print(paste("Sensitivity:", round(youden_row$sensitivity, 3)))
print(paste("Specificity:", round(youden_row$specificity, 3)))

print("--- STRICT (>= 95% Specificity) Cutoff ---")
print(paste("Cutoff:", round(strict_row$threshold, 3)))
print(paste("Sensitivity:", round(strict_row$sensitivity, 3)))
print(paste("Specificity:", round(strict_row$specificity, 3)))

# 6. Manual Plotting with ggplot2
p_roc <- ggplot(roc_table, aes(x = fpr, y = sensitivity)) +
  # The Curve
  geom_path(linewidth = 1) +
  # Diagonal Line
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey") +
  
  # A. Standard Point (Red) - Optional, commented out as per your previous code
   geom_point(data = youden_row, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity), color = "red", size = 3) +
   geom_label(data = youden_row, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity, 
              label = paste("Balanced:", round(threshold, 2))), nudge_y = 0.05, color = "red") +
  
  # B. Strict Point (Blue)
  #geom_point(data = strict_row, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity), color = "blue", size = 3) +
  #geom_label(data = strict_row, aes(x = 1 - specificity, y = sensitivity, 
  #           label = paste("Strict (>95% Sp):", round(threshold, 2))), 
  #           nudge_y = -0.10, nudge_x = 0.05, color = "blue") +
  
  labs(title = paste("ROC Curve (AUC =", round(auc_val, 2), ")"),
       subtitle = "1974 ClinVar variants (3-star rating)",
       x = "False Positive Rate (1 - Specificity)",
       y = "True Positive Rate (Sensitivity)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14)

print(p_roc)
```
